integrity: Analytical derivation from a four-state invariant Lindblad sector, checked against the full two-qubit density-matrix propagator by a standalone 580-check program; no independent scientific or publication-priority audit.
scientific_limitations: Proved for a homogeneous two-qubit XX Hamiltonian with J>h>0, a specified GKLS damping matrix, Gibbs initial state at finite nonnegative inverse temperature, and global ergotropy. The slow-time limit is uniform away from zero slow time. No extension to other quantum batteries or microscopically different baths; an exactly passive finite-time plateau is not asserted. The collective critical inverse-temperature equation and subradiant rate mechanism are prior work.
title: A singular long-time ergotropy frontier in a nearly collective XX battery
